title: CKA mock exam 3 - review
description: The hardest set: multi-step scenarios that mix domains, the way the real exam does.

questions.prompt: After a cluster upgrade, kubectl get nodes shows the control plane on the new version and the worker on the old one. What has not happened yet?

options.text: kubeadm upgrade node plus a kubelet upgrade on the worker

questions.explanation: Each worker is upgraded separately: drain, kubeadm upgrade node, upgrade kubelet, uncordon.

questions.prompt: A PersistentVolume with reclaimPolicy Retain is released. What is the state of the data?

options.text: Kept; the PV must be cleaned or deleted by hand before reuse

questions.explanation: Retain keeps the volume and its data; an admin decides what happens next.

questions.prompt: Which command shows a container's logs from its previous crash?
questions.explanation: --previous reads the log of the last terminated instance of the container.

questions.prompt: A Pod needs to reach an external IP but an egress NetworkPolicy blocks it. Which rule type allows a CIDR?
questions.explanation: ipBlock is the only selector that names IP ranges; the others select Pods by labels.

questions.prompt: Which command approves a CertificateSigningRequest named akshay?
questions.explanation: certificate approve (and certificate deny) are the CSR verbs.

questions.prompt: kube-scheduler is Running but nothing gets scheduled. What is a likely cause in a kubeadm cluster?

options.text: A typo in the scheduler static Pod manifest making it crash-loop or misconfigured

questions.explanation: The scheduler is a static Pod; a bad flag or path in its manifest is the classic control plane fault.

questions.prompt: Which object lets a Pod authenticate to the API server?

options.text: A ServiceAccount and its projected token

questions.explanation: Pods run as a ServiceAccount; the kubelet projects a short-lived token for it.

questions.prompt: A HorizontalPodAutoscaler shows <unknown> for CPU. What is missing?

options.text: The Metrics Server, or CPU requests on the Pods

questions.explanation: The HPA needs metrics (metrics-server) and a request to compute a percentage against.

questions.prompt: Which Helm command installs a chart with a values override?
questions.explanation: --set (or -f values.yaml) on helm install or upgrade.

questions.prompt: In Kustomize, which file section changes an image tag across a whole project?
questions.explanation: images: [{name, newTag}] is the image transformer.

questions.prompt: Which kubectl command shows the last-applied configuration stored by apply?

options.text: kubectl get <kind> <name> -o yaml and read the annotation kubectl.kubernetes.io/last-applied-configuration

questions.explanation: apply stores the last applied manifest in an annotation on the object.

questions.prompt: The API server cannot reach etcd after someone rotated certificates. Which manifest do you check?
questions.explanation: The API server's etcd client certificates are flags on its static Pod.

questions.prompt: Which resource makes a Pod run once per node, including new nodes?
questions.explanation: DaemonSets schedule one Pod onto every (matching) node as nodes join.

questions.prompt: A Gateway API HTTPRoute is Accepted but traffic does not flow. What else must exist?

options.text: A Gateway with a listener the route's parentRef points at, backed by a controller

questions.explanation: HTTPRoutes attach to Gateways; without a matching Gateway and controller there is no data path.

questions.prompt: Which command sorts Pods by restart count?
questions.explanation: --sort-by takes a JSONPath expression; restartCount lives on each containerStatus.
